## At a glance

- **Question settled.** Does the Party take the Vessen ledger and speak its truth, or do the Reedrunners take it and sell it?
- **Stakes.** The ledger, the rest of Sable's trust and the safety of the Party as the tide returns.
- **Where.** The bell loft of [[The Drowned Chapel]].
- **Opposition.** [[Sable]] and three [[Goblin Warrior]] hands of [[The Reedrunners]].

> [!narration] Opening
> The tower stair is forty steps of wet stone, and the rope at the top swings without wind. Above you, a bell as tall as a man hangs in the dark, warm to the eye and cold to the ear. A grey woman stands beside it with one hand on the rope, watching you climb. Behind you, boots ring on the nave floor, and a goblin's voice calls up the stairwell in Common. "Nothing personal," it says. "The captain wants the book."

## Threads

- In [[The Silent Bell]], Sable rings the bell for the last time unless the Party speaks the names.
- In [[Reedrunner Tithe]], Ilse's hands arrive to take the ledger by force.

## Play

### Situation

Sable will hand the ledger to anyone who says the names of the drowned aloud. She does not want a fight, but she will defend the bell. Three Reedrunner hands are climbing the stair. They are under orders to take the ledger without killing anyone, and they will run if the Party holds the loft.

### Pressure

- The goblins arrive at the loft in 3 rounds.
- The tide returns about an hour after the Party arrives. Each hour after that, the nave floods 1 foot deeper.
- If Sable is attacked she makes a Drowning Grasp and the bell stops ringing.

### Checks

- Speaking the names moves Sable. It takes a DC 12 Charisma (Persuasion) check, or none if the Party has read Nib's tally-sticks.
- Holding the stair takes a DC 13 Strength (Athletics) check or a Dex save against the falling rope.
- Reading the ledger's marked page takes a DC 12 Intelligence (History) check.

### Encounter

![[Mire Drowner#Statblock]]

![[Goblin Warrior#Statblock]]

Sable uses the Mire Drowner stat block. Three Goblin Warriors are 150 XP and Sable is 200 XP, for 350 XP in total. That is under the Low budget of 450 XP for three level 3 characters, and Sable fights only if provoked.

## Outcomes

| If                                           | Then                                                          | Hands to                             |
| -------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------ |
| The Party speaks the names                   | Sable gives up the ledger and the goblins flee down the stair | [[Session 2 - What the Ledger Says]] |
| The Party fights Sable                       | The goblins take the ledger in the confusion                  | [[Session 2 - What the Ledger Says]] |
| The Party holds the stair and takes the book | The goblins retreat, and Sable watches without helping        | [[Session 2 - What the Ledger Says]] |

## Depth

### Hidden truths

- The ledger is signed by Corvin Tarrow, the Compact's clerk. The Party can learn this from the marked page.
- The tidemarks cut into the lowest stones of the tower are older than the chapel. The Party can find them on the way down by the stair.

### Spotlight

- [[Odalys Ferro]] can lead the naming and ends the church's silence by speaking for it.
- [[Tamsin Wick]] can read the Vessen script, which she learned from [[Ilse Corran]].
